title: NotifyEvent
description: What happened, as a service tells it.

cleared.description: Whether a problem the service raised about itself is cleared.

event.description: Which of the four happenings it is.

name.description: The title's name, or the service's own words for a problem about itself.

reason.description: What the service said went wrong, where something did.

reference.description: The title it is about, by the service's own reference, where it is about one.
